description: Create or remove a link between two memories over the from_id -> to_id edge. Curated relationships in the memory graph; [[wikilinks]] in a memory body already link automatically on remember, so use this for a relationship the body does not spell out. Both ids are memory ids in your space. Pass remove=true to delete the link instead of creating it.

fromId.description:
from_id is the memory the link starts at; to_id is the memory it points to.
 Both are memory (collection) ids in the caller's space.

remove.description: remove deletes the from_id -> to_id link instead of creating it.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

toId.description: to_id is the target memory the link points to (see from_id).

name: link_memory
title: Link two memories
